_help: Default lists for the create-ticket skill: applications, developers per team, QA and the general assignee.

A plugin update replaces this file. To change the lists for yourself, edit ~/.claude/sdlc-core/ticket-creation.json (Windows: %USERPROFILE%\.claude\sdlc-core\ticket-creation.json); a key there replaces the same key here.
A project profile (.sdlc/project.json -> ticketCreation) overrides both.
To change the lists for everyone who uses this repo, edit this file and commit it.
priorities.default: priority names in the order shown (empty = all Jira priorities, in Jira's order). priorities.bySpace: a different list for one Jira space.
applications: add or remove projects; each has urlKeywords and teams.backend / teams.frontend / teams.qa. A person is a name, or { "name": "...", "email": "..." }.
qa: QA people shared by every application. generalAssignee: optional, adds a General option.

subtaskWording: wording of the sub-tasks created when several people work on a ticket. Backend and frontend get a Fix sub-task for a Bug and, through forNonBug, an Implement sub-task for a Story or Task; QA gets a Test sub-task. {KEY} is the parent ticket and {issue} its issue name. Edit the text or add a team.
description.elaborate: true = the skill analyses your request and screenshots, writes a fuller problem description and shows it for approval; false = it uses your words as they are.

mode: auto = the skill predicts everything the evidence supports (application, team, assignee, priority, sprint, type) and asks only what it cannot decide, then shows one preview | manual = it asks you every decision as a select-only question, with its prediction marked Recommended. (ask means the same as manual.)
sprint.mode: follow = decided automatically when mode is auto, asked when mode is manual | ask | auto | current | backlog (fix it whatever mode says).
media.maxFrames: frames read from one screen recording (needs ffmpeg). similar.maxResults: existing Jira records read per search.

environments: the environments offered when the request and screenshots do not name one, in this order (edit freely). The names follow the six environment files of bloomlink-api (core dev/stage/staging, healthcare dev/stage/prod); change them to your own.
structure: parent = every ticket is a parent ticket for the general assignee plus one sub-task per developer and one for QA (QA is mandatory) | single = one person gives one ticket, no sub-tasks.
inference.qa: always = a QA sub-task on every ticket, never asked | when-asked | never (the last two only apply with structure: single).

backend.description: Investigate and fix {issue} on the backend. Details are in {KEY}.

forNonBug.description: Implement {issue} on the backend. Details are in {KEY}.

frontend.description: Investigate and fix {issue} on the frontend. Details are in {KEY}.

forNonBug.description: Implement {issue} on the frontend. Details are in {KEY}.

qa.description: Test and verify {issue} once the fix is ready, and record the result on this sub-task. Details are in {KEY}.
